[SWS_DM_01026] Resetting the status of an
Event
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04151
⌈
If the parameter
action
in the function
ara::diag::Monitor::ReportMoni-
torAction
is set to
kResetTestFailed
, the DM shall update the
Event status
by setting
only
the "
kTestFailed
" bit to FALSE and leave all other bits unchanged.
⌋
Rationale: This is an AUTOSAR-specific additional reset condition for the ’
kTest-
Failed
’ bit of the
Event status
bits.
